onChange.script:
log = system.util.getLogger('kanoaSecurity')
	try: 	#wrap this in try block in case client is not using our security schema
		userId = system.kanoa.security.storeNewIDPUser(self.session.props.auth)
		if len(system.kanoa.security.getUsers({'gatewayAdmin': True})) == 0: system.kanoa.security.updateUserField(userId, 'gatewayAdmin', 1, userId)

		secConfig = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.security.getConfig({}), 'configName', 'configValue')
		userCRUD = system.kanoa.security.getUserAssetCRUD(userId)
	
		self.session.custom.kanoa['security'] = {"userId": userId, "config": secConfig, "userCRUD": userCRUD}

	except:
		log.warn("Unable to storeNewIDPUser")
		pass

	secConfig = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.security.getConfig({}), 'configName', 'configValue')
	userCRUD = system.kanoa.security.getUserAssetCRUD(userId)

	sessionSecurity = {"userId": userId, "config": secConfig, "userCRUD": userCRUD}
	log.trace("Setting session security to %s"%sessionSecurity)
	self.session.custom.kanoa['security'] = sessionSecurity		
	
	return
